department.instructions: Which department should handle this customer message?

criteria.billing: invoices, charges, refunds, payment problems, price or subscription cost questions
criteria.technical: bugs, outages, login problems, errors, data export problems
criteria.sales: new customers asking about offers, pricing for new contracts, plan upgrades and extra users
criteria.other: compliments, feedback, feature ideas and anything that does not fit the other departments

urgency.instructions: How urgent is this customer message?
criteria: not urgent: general question, feedback or request with no deadline or with weeks of time
soon: needs an answer within a few days, limited impact on the customer
critical: service is down, money is being lost, or the customer demands action today

churn_risk.instructions: Does the customer say they will cancel the plan, terminate the contract or switch to another provider?
